**Cumania IV: the war's two nations are named and coloured.** Agartha and Recallia now come with their flag, official name and colour (from the site's countries.json and the war map), so the war menu, the scores and the cities show them like any other nation, and the war view still draws their capture limits as their land. (For Minecraft 26.1.x, 26.2 and 26.3.)
